question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        MAX(im.composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY im.interest_id
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.max_composition
    FROM max_composition mc
    JOIN interest_map im ON mc.interest_id = im.id
    ORDER BY mc.max_composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.max_composition
    FROM max_composition mc
    JOIN interest_map im ON mc.interest_id = im.id
    ORDER BY mc.max_composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
),
top10_with_month AS (
    SELECT 
        im2.month_year,
        im2.interest_id,
        im2.composition
    FROM interest_metrics im2
    JOIN top10 t ON im2.interest_id = t.interest_id AND im2.composition = t.max_composition
),
bottom10_with_month AS (
    SELECT 
        im2.month_year,
        im2.interest_id,
        im2.composition
    FROM interest_metrics im2
    JOIN bottom10 b ON im2.interest_id = b.interest_id AND im2.composition = b.max_composition
)
SELECT 
    m.month_year,
    im.interest_name,
    m.composition
FROM top10_with_month m
JOIN interest_map im ON m.interest_id = im.id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    m.month_year,
    im.interest_name,
    m.composition
FROM bottom10_with_month m
JOIN interest_map im ON m.interest_id = im.id
ORDER BY composition DESC
